section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1986
title: 21 of suicides. The remaining 7 states registered a dcline over 1985. The highest increase in suicides was registered in Jammu & Kashmir (81.3%). The second highest increase in suicides was registered in Mizoram (64.7%), followed by Sikkam (64.0%). The 7 states which registered a decline in the number of suicide cases were Bihar, Manipur, Uttar Pradesh, Tripura, West Bengal, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. All the Union Territories taken together registered an increase of 24.0 per cent in the total number of suicides during 1986 over 1985. Out of 7 U.Ts., 6 U.Ts. registered an increase in the total number of suicides during 1986 over 1985 and only one i.e. Lakshadweep did not register any cases of suicide during 1986 and 1985.
